description:
Two pre-existing clippy warnings in jmap-mail-server tests (NOT introduced by JMAP-tco1.32):

1. crate-jmap-mail-server/tests/common/mod.rs:2621 — `type_part.splitn(2, '/').next()` should be `type_part.split('/').next()` per clippy::needless_splitn.

2. crate-jmap-mail-server/tests/mdn_integration.rs:153 — `Some(&[email_id.clone()])` should be `Some(std::slice::from_ref(&email_id))` per clippy::cloned_ref_to_slice_refs.

Confirmed pre-existing on main HEAD a10c926 (before JMAP-tco1.32 changes). Out of scope for the cookie-cutter sweep.

## Acceptance criteria
- `cargo clippy -p jmap-mail-server --all-features --tests -- -D warnings` is clean
- `cargo test -p jmap-mail-server --all-features` still passes
